readme.text:
# Fantastic Fist Fantastic Fist, released in 2024 by 100th Coin, is a 2D platformer which uses both Keyboard controls to move the protagonist Vivi, and mouse controls to move a giant fist to interact with the environment.
# Fantastic-Fist-Archipelago-Client An Archipelago Client for the game Fantastic Fist
Items include level gimmicks and coins.
Locations include coins, level exits, boss hearts, and tutorial panels.
The randomizer can be set up to have a more standard playthrough, or it can be set up to be open world.
# Setup You will need:
Fantastic Fist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2119470/Fantastic_Fist/
Archipelago: https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases
Melonloader: https://melonwiki.xyz/#/
The Fantastic Fist Archipelago Client: https://github.com/DannySchultzDev/Fantastic-Fist-Archipelago-Client/releases
The Fantastic Fist AP World: https://github.com/DannySchultzDev/Fantastic-Fist-Archipelago-Client/releases

Setting up the AP World:
Put the AP World in your custom worlds folder either manually, double clicking it, or using the "Install APWorld" option in the Archipelago Launcher.
Generate the options .YAML file by using the "Generate Template Options" option in the Archipelago Launcher.
Place the Fantastic Fist.yaml in your players folder.
Edit the options in the Fantastic Fist.yaml.
Generate the multiworld using the "Generate" option in the Archipelago Launcher. (It will be placed in your C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\output folder)
Upload the world to https://archipelago.gg/uploads, or unzip it and run the .archipelago to run it locally.

Setting up the mod:
Open the MelonLoader Installer.
Select Fantastic Fist.
Install MelonLoader **7.1**. (Later versions will throw an error when trying to hook into the game)
Extract the files in the Fantastic Fist Archipelago Client zip.
Place the files in the zip in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Fantastic Fist\Mods.
Run Fantastic Fist, instead of seeing your save files you should see a connection screen. (Archipelago uses a normally unused 4th save file so you don't need to worry about losing your progress)
Input your connection information. (use arrow keys to move your selection and Enter to confirm)
Enjoy!

notes.text:
Deathlink support added, including Deathlink amnesty.

Fixed a bug where the game would crash when loading a level after loading the Universal Bearing Collectible.

Currently Roomsanity, Checkpointsanity, and Door Rando do not work. They will be implemented at a later date.
